articles.summary: ORLANDO, Fla., Sept. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Nutriband Inc. (NASDAQ:NTRB) (NASDAQ:NTRBW) confirmed today that its outstanding warrants (NASDAQ:NTRBW) will expire on September 30, 2026 at 5PM ET as scheduled. The Company will not extend the expiration date and will not reprice the warrants. Warrant holders may exercise at the current strike price of $6.43 per share until the expiration date.
